note:
R71 - PS4 EA-MP3 (SNS codec 0x0b): where do the 1 152 embedded PCM samples belong, and does the sized-frame contract hold up
against malformed input? (read-only over the banks; temporary .mp3/.wav in R71_SCRATCH, removed unless --keep)

Coordinator review 2026-09-22 F2: keep the embedded PCM's role open, verify robustness before handing over a contract, treat
ffmpeg `mp3` / `mp3float` as one code base. This probe measures, on the same 24 vectors as r61 / r67:

  T1 junction scan   for every lag L in [0, 2400]: how well does the decoded stream continued from sample L follow the embedded PCM?
                     Measured with a linear-prediction model (order 16) fitted on the PCM's tail and applied across the splice, and the
                     mirror model fitted on the decoded side predicting backwards into the PCM; the normalised residual is the junction
                     cost J(L). Reported: argmin L, J at the candidate lags 0 (pre-roll), 529 (decoder delay), 576 (encoder delay),
                     1105 (encoder + decoder delay), 1152 (replace frame 0), 2257 (replace + delay), the median J over all L, and the same
                     scan with ANOTHER vector's PCM as a control (a real junction must beat the control by a margin at a consistent L).
  T2 cross-correlation   normalised cross-correlation of the full embedded PCM against the decoded stream over lags 0..4000 (FFT), best
                     lag + value, second-best, and the control (other vector's PCM).
  T3 onset           where the decoded stream's energy first rises (the MPEG decoder's warm-up / delay zone), in samples.
  T4 tail            the decoded stream's trailing near-silence, compared with the declared trim (frames x 1152 - num_samples), with
                     trim + 47 and with trim + 1152 (the three hypotheses give different tails); weak evidence, reported as such.
  T5 robustness      the r67 grammar parser exercised on mutated copies of each vector's blocks: a truncated last block, a size word
                     pointing past the payload, a size word shortened by one, the 0x8000 flag forced onto a later frame, pcm_samples
                     forced to 0 / 4096, and a dropped middle block (reservoir continuity: main_data_begin of the next frame vs the
                     bytes actually available). Every mutation must be *refused by name*, never decoded silently.
  T6 reservoir       on the unmodified stream, for every frame: main_data_begin <= reservoir bytes accumulated from the previous
                     frames (MPEG-1 mono: frame bytes - 4 header - 17 side info - CRC), so the concatenated stream is self-consistent.

Usage: python r71_ea_mp3_embedded_pcm.py <out.json> [--titles nhl15,nhl16,nhl17] [--per-title 8] [--keep]
